title: F10.7 proxy drift and confidence guard

proxy_drift_experiment.name: F10.7 and sunspot-number relation drift
proxy_drift_experiment.interpretation: Slope changes across windows indicate possible proxy-relation drift and should lower confidence for single-proxy hypotheses.

self_corrections.before: Cycle-26 strength could be stated from sunspot/F10.7 proxies or from historical polar-field correlation alone.
self_corrections.after: Use WSO as a historical precursor constraint, but keep Cycle-26 amplitude bounded until the Cycle-25/26 minimum-time polar field is mature and cross-validated.
self_corrections.reason: NOAA prediction series currently extends to late Cycle 25 / minimum approach; this is not an official Cycle 26 amplitude forecast. WSO complete precursor pairs = 4.

self_corrections.before: Treat F10.7 as a stable one-to-one proxy for sunspot number.
self_corrections.after: Lower confidence for single-proxy hypotheses and request phase-stratified reanalysis.
self_corrections.reason: Slope changes across windows indicate possible proxy-relation drift and should lower confidence for single-proxy hypotheses.

self_corrections.before: Use hemispheric asymmetry as if it covered the full 1749-present interval.
self_corrections.after: Use asymmetry as modern-era mechanism evidence only, because the available SILSO hemispheric product begins in 1992.
self_corrections.reason: Coverage starts at 1992.042 and ends at 2026.371.

verification_points: 系统把 F10.7 当作有用 proxy，而不是稳定的一一对应内部物理量。
漂移检测会触发对单 proxy 推理的置信度修正。
输出沿用主案例的 claim boundary，不把 proxy prior 写成确定性预报。
